answer: When an agent joins the network it must stake a cryptographic ember token in the identity vault and receive a vouch from three existing agents whose cumulative reputation reaches the summit threshold; each vouch records the staked amount and a time‑locked expiry. If any vouched agent is later proven false, its vouchers lose 100 % of their stake, which is burned. An attacker therefore must lock and risk 10 ember tokens per fake identity and wait the full expiry period, typically 72 hours, to keep the identity alive.
